scope: Cold CPU-only numeric metadata planning; all 159 native descriptors and 72 registered shapes. No transactions, witnesses, GPU work, or recursive proofs generated.
host: AMD Ryzen 9 5900XT, 16 physical cores, 64 GiB installed RAM; spread placement across L3 groups.

implemented_priorities.change: Active native jobs hold compiler growth grants; idle workers charge exact retained map backing. Credit is returned only after worker-owned destruction or a successful retained-byte census.

Admission includes the entire existing live set, thread stacks/TLS, coordinator, shared periodic tables, retained graphs, active compiler grants, and the larger of preparation or compilation for the next job.
Drain every available queue completion before preparing another graph; preserve bounded retries and joined failure/panic handling.

Use checked NonZeroU32 wire encodings to reduce compiler-map slot padding; preserve public wire validation and full-key equality. Trim oversized backing on activation and idle backing when admission stalls.
Automatically request a native phase supplement from the same authenticated workflow ledger, with owner-bound lifetime and no increase to per-compiler or process caps.

defaults.supplement_behavior: Authenticated cohorts with more than eight cache misses and a worker ceiling above eight may claim available ledger capacity. If a claim cannot be funded, the same scheduler remains within already reserved bytes. Every claim is retired after workers join.
defaults.reason: The implementation has one automatic ledger-backed memory policy and no original/extended mode switch. Sixteen workers improved native planning throughput; the extra memory itself did not establish a consistent speedup in the development comparison.

interpretation.scope_limits: Component times do not predict full transaction creation or recursive proving speed. Generic perf cache counters do not isolate memory bandwidth or a particular cache level. Observed cgroup memory is diagnostic, not admission authority.
interpretation.peak_worker_definition: Baseline counts queue jobs; new native measurements count active compilation callbacks and exclude buffer-maintenance jobs.
interpretation.retry_note: Public-geometry initial caps are heuristics. Some samples required one joined byte-cap retry; no other failure is retried. All 159 mathematical results remained equal.
